parameters.title: Predict indicators for independent spectra with saved regression models
parameters.label: Apply one or more models saved by regression_modeling (the whole fitted chain: preprocessing, regressor and indicator transformation) to unprocessed spectra. Saves <dataframe>_pred.parquet with one column per model in the native unit of the indicator; if the dataframe holds observed values, metrics are computed on the samples not used for training, and the observed vs predicted plots are shown/saved as in regression_modeling.

parameter.hint: The root fp of the project (folder with the parquet file to predict).

The dataframe with unprocessed spectra to predict: raw = the selected parquet, previous = the latest saved parquet, or the name of a parquet file. The spectra must have the same bands and signal type as the source parquet of the model.
Comma separated list of saved models: .joblib paths relative to the project root (each needs its .manifest.json) or names of registered models (ml_model.model).
Folder for the predictions (<dataframe>_pred.parquet + .json), relative to the project root. Empty = <project_root_fp>/predictions.
Show the observed vs predicted plots (only for models whose indicator has observed values in the dataframe).
Save one observed vs predicted plot per model, under <dst_fp>/plot/.

How the shown plots are arranged, as in regression_modeling: default (one indicator per row when several regressors predict it; train/test and k-fold models side by side), a preset (scatter-1 … scatter-4, scatter-tt-kf), a custom plot_layout parameter set, a JSON file, or none (one figure per model).
Also save the grid figures of plot_layout, under <dst_fp>/plot/grid/.
The symbolisation of indicators: default, a plot_symbol parameter set or a JSON file.
The symbolisation of regressors: default, a plot_symbol parameter set or a JSON file.
